title: OWASP Top 10
description: Understand and mitigate OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

data.text: OWASP Top 10 lists critical security risks. Understand injection, broken authentication, XSS, and other vulnerabilities.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: OWASP Top 10 provides a security baseline. Understand each vulnerability and implement mitigations in your applications.
